name: Documentary Explainer
story_structure: cold open with human detail or contradiction

visual_language.motion: restrained; evidence readability wins over animation
visual_language.typography: editorial serif or clean sans with source labels
visual_language.color: natural, archival, warm paper, or neutral documentary palette

asset_strategy.generated_visual_policy: Only for illustrative reconstructions or abstract concepts; label internally and never present as evidence.

sound.music: restrained documentary bed or sparse pulse
sound.sfx: subtle paper, projector, map, data, and transition cues

qc: every factual claim has a source
maps/charts/documents are readable after style treatment
asset rights and attribution are manifest-ready
generated or illustrative visuals are not treated as archival proof
